title: Let Them Think Bad Thoughts about You
coreMove: Stop trying to control what other people privately think of you, and the energy you wasted predicting their judgment comes back for the life you actually want.

exampleSpecs.audience: Zora and readers facing opinion release
exampleSpecs.stakes: Reputation management can become the obstacle that prevents meaningful work from reaching people.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Show Zora using opinion release in the source case without controlling another person.

exampleSpecs.domain: Source case: Mary Oliver's life question
